== Fan projects drive listing ==

A short [[Fan projects]] section was added for the Google Drive folder listed under the name Chrknudsen in the 9 January 2021 stickied r/starwarsccgalters post. Chrknudsen is the forums and GEMP handle already given in the lead, so the folder is treated as [[Christian Knudsen]]'s.

Post: [https://www.reddit.com/r/starwarsccgalters/comments/ku0xau/mpc_print_ready_cards_links_to_drives_and/ MPC Print Ready Cards - Links to drives and community disclaimer], r/starwarsccgalters, 9 January 2021. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008193145/https://www.reddit.com/r/starwarsccgalters/comments/ku0xau/mpc_print_ready_cards_links_to_drives_and/ Internet Archive]. Drive: [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1tDJC5bZ7Ul9B_-QjMXl38aw2k8trN4-R SW:CCG].
